method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Trump announces deal with Venezuela to secure more than 65 billion barrels of oil reserves
Equities.summary: The U.S. struck a deal with Venezuela to get majority control of more than 65 billion barrels of oil reserves, Trump said in a social media post.
Equities.reason: Geopolitical policy around major oil reserves increases geopolitical risk and policy uncertainty; likely to lift energy prices while weighing on broad risk assets and investor sentiment. Relevant to equity regime via energy/geo-risk transmission.

Equities.title: Stock Market Today: Oil Climbs on Fresh Mideast Flare-Up
Equities.reason: Mideast escalation pushing oil higher — classic risk-off impulse that pressures cyclicals and broad indices even as energy names benefit. Strong market-moving geopolitical/commodity transmission into equities.

Equities.title: Stock futures fall after U.S. strikes Iran; Wall Street heads for winning month
Equities.reason: Immediate market reaction to US strikes on Iran: futures drop and volatility rises. Significant near-term negative for broad equities via heightened geopolitical risk and safe-haven flows.

Equities.title: Why the software sector’s ‘epic’ rally could run through October
Equities.reason: Continued strong AI/software leadership is a dominant market-regime narrative; if sustained it supports tech outperformance and index gains even amid macro/geo shocks. High relevance for market structure and sector leadership.

Equities.title: Wall Street is turning Nvidia's AI chips into a new futures market
Equities.reason: Nvidia/AI productization and market structuring around AI chips reinforces the leadership trade and concentrated equity gains — positive for tech-heavy indices and thematic flows.

Equities.title: Stock futures flat as chances of rate hike rise after Jackson Hole
Equities.reason: Rising odds of further Fed tightening (Jackson Hole messaging) lift rate-sensitivity concerns — negative for duration-sensitive growth/high-multiple stocks and overall risk appetite.

Equities.title: China's factory activity shrinks for second straight month, contracting less than expected
Equities.summary: China's manufacturing activity shrank for a second straight month, keeping pressure on Beijing to support the economy as growth loses momentum.
Equities.reason: China PMI contraction is a key global growth headwind that pressures cyclicals, commodity-sensitive stocks and EM-linked sectors — negative for global equity backdrop unless offset by stimulus.

Equities.title: Corporate earnings have grown at a blistering pace. Why that likely won't last.
Equities.reason: Analysis suggesting corporate profit acceleration is peaking. Weighs on forward equity multiples and supports a more cautious market stance; moderate relevance to medium-term returns.

Equities.title: The Sudden Unraveling of Wall Street’s Momentum Trade
Equities.reason: Disruption to momentum strategies indicates possible broad-market rotation and higher volatility; relevant to flow-driven equity dynamics and concentrated leadership risks.

Rates.title: US Dollar: Hawkish Fed pricing supports Dollar into payrolls – BBH
Rates.summary: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad notes that Kevin Warsh’s hawkish Jackson Hole speech has sharply increased market-implied odds of a September Federal Reserve rate hike, supporting the Dollar and short-term Treasury yields.
Rates.reason: Direct Fed-hawk signal: Warsh speech lifts odds of near-term Fed hikes and supports short-term Treasury yields. In rates terms this is a bond-negative (yields higher / prices lower) driver with material market impact on Treasuries.

Rates.title: Japan’s bonds and yen under pressure after Warsh’s Jackson Hole speech
Rates.summary: Currency weakens past ¥160 a dollar and yields rise to highest in three decades as investors raise bets on monetary tightening
Rates.reason: Clear rates-focused story: Jackson Hole hawkishness has pushed JGB yields sharply higher (multi-decade highs). Strong negative for bond prices in Japan and indicative of global higher-for-longer repricing.

Rates.title: Bond Investors Wary After Warsh Fans Wagers Fed Poised to Hike
Rates.reason: Market reaction piece: analysts/investors responding to hawkish Fed commentary by increasing hike wagers and reducing bond exposure. Bond-negative (yields up) with meaningful investor flow amplification.

Rates.title: Stocks cautious on US-Iran escalation, bond yields hit multi-year highs
Rates.reason: Cross-market driver: geopolitical escalation combined with hawkish Fed bets has pushed yields to multi-year highs. Reinforces a selloff narrative for sovereign bonds (negative for prices, positive for yields).

Rates.title: German 10-Year Bund Yield Hits 15-Year High on Fresh Middle East Escalation
Rates.reason: Bund yields moving sharply higher on geopolitical risk and global repricing; bond-negative for European core rates and indicative of broader risk premia rising in government bond markets.

Rates.title: Jackson Hole analyst roundup: Warsh's speech sends hike chances higher, may put Fed `at odds' with Treasury
Rates.reason: Analyst consensus piece: Warsh elevated near-term hike probabilities, creating frictions between fiscal/treasury positioning and the Fed — negative for bond prices as rate expectations rise, but somewhat more commentary-driven than primary data.

Rates.title: Indian rupee under pressure from Fed, oil; bonds at risk of further selloff
Rates.reason: EM rates transmission: stronger Fed bets and oil shocks press EM FX and raise the risk of additional bond selling in local markets. Negative for EM sovereign and corporate bond prices (higher local yields).

Rates.title: Treasury Yields Dip, Stocks Steady as Oil Rises: Markets Wrap
Rates.reason: Intraday counter-signal: notes a dip in Treasury yields which offers temporary relief for bonds. Low relevance as a minor, short-lived move against the dominant hawkish/selloff narrative.

Rates.title: Australian Dollar: RBA hike risks linger – OCBC
Rates.summary: OCBC FX Strategist Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note that stronger Australian Consumer Price Index (CPI) and resilient household spending have revived expectations of another Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) hike, helping AUD/USD retest resistance near 0.
Rates.reason: Local central-bank risk: renewed RBA hike expectations imply upward pressure on Australian yields. Relevant to domestic bond markets but lower relevance to the global Treasury narrative.

Rates.title: GPIF Would Be Justified in Buying More Japan Bonds, Analysts Say
Rates.reason: Potential demand-support signal: large domestic buyer (GPIF) advocated for increasing JGB purchases could provide support to Japanese bond prices, a modest positive counter to recent JGB selloff.

FX.title: Indian Rupee: Growth supports INR against US Dollar – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank strategists highlight resilient domestic growth, supported by strong industrial production and investment activity ahead of the Q2 GDP release. The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) expects growth to moderate to 6.7% in FY2026-27 while inflation remains
FX.reason: Domestic growth/investment-led support is a clear USD-to-INR flow driver implying INR strength vs USD. Relevant for EMFX flows but not a global FX regime shift, so medium relevance.

FX.title: Indian Rupee drops amid renewed Middle East tensions, hawkish Fed bets
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens slightly lower against the US Dollar (USD) at the start of the week. The USD/INR pair ticks up to near 95.43, as higher oil prices due to renewed tensions between the United States (US) and Iran have weighed on the Indian currency.
FX.reason: Geo-risk driven oil-price rise plus renewed hawkish Fed bets lift USD and weigh on oil-importing INR — a high-signal, market-impacting driver for INR/USD.

FX.title: US Dollar: Warsh speech supports greenback – DBS
FX.summary: DBS Group Research economist Philip Wee notes that the US Dollar (USD) recovered after Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh’s Jackson Hole speech, as futures pricing restored a meaningful probability of a September FOMC rate hike.
FX.reason: Jackson Hole comments that lift Fed hike odds are a direct USD-positive macro driver; this is a core USD-rate transmission and highly relevant for FX positioning.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar: RBNZ set for second hike – BNY
FX.summary: BNY’s Geoff Yu expects the Reserve Bank of New Zealand to deliver another 25bp hike to 2.75%, supported by elevated inflation and strong confidence data.
FX.reason: Another RBNZ hike prospect is a clear NZD-supporting yield differential story vs USD — directly relevant for NZD/USD flows and EM/proxy FX.

FX.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: DXY fails near 100-SMA/38.2% Fibo. confluence around 99.75
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, attracts some sellers at the start of a new week and erodes a part of Friday's strong gains to a two-week high.
FX.reason: Technical DXY pullback suggests limited USD weakness vs basket; technical-note relevance is capped but still informative for short-term FX flows.

FX.title: Yen’s Breach of 160 to Dollar Puts Traders on Intervention Watch
FX.reason: JPY trading around/through 160 raises explicit intervention risk — a market-moving USD/JPY dynamic. Strong negative for JPY (USD positive) with high relevance for global FX positioning.

FX.title: Forex Today: Tensions re-escalate in Mideast, USD consolidates Fed-inspired rally
FX.summary: Here is what you need to know on Monday, August 31:
FX.reason: Combines geopolitics (Mideast tensions) with a Fed-driven USD rally — a broad, high-relevance narrative supporting USD strength and risk repricing across FX.

FX.title: Euro: Downside risk remains in focus against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann highlight an unexpectedly sharp EUR/USD drop to 1.1577, with the pair closing weaker at 1.1584. They see scope for further downside but doubts a quick test of 1.1550 due to oversold conditions.
FX.reason: Analyst note flags EUR downside vs USD after a sharp drop — relevant for EUR/USD flows but framed as a tactical/short-term risk rather than regime change.

FX.title: Australian Dollar: Pullback risk toward 0.7120 against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note AUD/USD briefly broke above 0.7200 to 0.7208 before reversing to 0.7158. Intraday, they expect further pullback toward 0.7145, with limited downside and resistance at 0.7170/0.7185.
FX.reason: Tactical AUD/USD pullback call — indicates USD strength on intraday horizons; technical/short-term analyst view so limited relevance.

FX.title: British Pound: Downside risks with 1.3480 in sight against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann report that GBP/USD fell sharply to 1.3527 and closed at 1.3540, contradicting expectations for range trading. Intraday, they see limited further losses within 1.3520–1.3570 due to oversold conditions
FX.reason: GBP shown under near-term pressure vs USD — a tactical USD-positive signal with moderate relevance for G10 FX flows.

FX.title: Swiss Franc edges up from 0.8100 as the US Dollar trims Friday’s gains
FX.summary: The Swiss Franc (CHF) shows moderate gains on Monday's early European session, as the US Dollar (USD) loses momentum with the dust of the Jackson Hole summit settling.
FX.reason: CHF strength reflects short-term USD retracement post-Jackson Hole — minor but relevant for safe-haven flows and G10 pairs.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar remains on the front foot vs soft USD; lacks bullish conviction
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair pulls back from an over two-week high, around the 1.3910-1.3915 region, earlier this Monday, stalling the recent goodish recovery from a three-month low. Spot prices, however, lack follow-through selling and trade just below the 1.3900 mark du
FX.reason: CAD showing gains as USD softens; energy-linked CAD moves matter for commodity-sensitive FX flows, but the note flags limited conviction so medium-low relevance.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar gathers strength above 0.5900 on stronger China PMI data
FX.summary: The NZD/USD pair gains momentum to near 0.5915 during the early European trading hours on Monday. Better-than-expected Chinese economic data provides some support to the China-proxy New Zealand Dollar (NZD) against the US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: China PMI-driven demand supports NZD vs USD — relevant for commodity-proxy FX but not a major USD regime shift.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Market needs more than BoJ pricing – OCBC
FX.summary: OCBC FX Strategist Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong highlight that the Japanese Yen (JPY) has already benefited from aggressive market pricing for Bank of Japan (BoJ) tightening, with an 85% chance of a September hike implied.
FX.reason: Market-implied BoJ tightening has been JPY-supportive, but OCBC cautions that pricing alone may not sustain gains — a relevant, though secondary, JPY-positive signal amid stronger intervention/160-level narrative.

Commodities.title: Gold: Fed hawkishness caps upside – ING
Commodities.summary: ING’s commodities team, led by Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey, reports that Gold came under pressure after Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh reinforced a higher-for-longer rates narrative, supporting the Dollar.
Commodities.reason: Fed hawkishness and stronger USD are a direct headwind for gold; important for precious metals but a routine market-moving rate-driven story (moderate relevance).

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD regains ground near $65.70, focus shifts to US NFP
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) is up 1% to near $67.00 during the European trading session on Monday. The white metal bounces back after a weak opening near $65.67, with investors shifting their focus to the United States (US) Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) data for August on
Commodities.reason: Short-term technical/price-forecast piece tied to macro data (NFP); limited structural signal for silver beyond near-term rate/data sensitivity (max relevance for forecast pieces).

Commodities.title: Brent: Hormuz tensions keep prices supported above $90 - ING
Commodities.summary: ING analysts Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note that oil prices, including ICE Brent, started the week stronger after US strikes on Iran raised concerns over Persian Gulf supply.
Commodities.reason: Direct geopolitical supply risk to Brent (Strait of Hormuz/Persian Gulf); large positive shock to oil risk premium and broad energy complex (high relevance).

Commodities.title: Oil rises 3% as U.S. strikes on Iran revive Hormuz supply disruption concerns
Commodities.reason: Reports of US strikes and renewed worries over Gulf shipping raise near-term oil supply disruption risk; strong positive for crude prices and energy complex flows (high relevance).

Commodities.title: U.S., Iran exchange strikes for first time since July as Trump threatens strategic oil hub
Commodities.summary: The last major U.S. strikes on Iran were carried out in late July.
Commodities.reason: Event-level geopolitical escalation in the Gulf increases energy risk premium and underpins higher oil prices; directly relevant to commodity price formation.

Commodities.title: Goldman Sachs Steps Up Warnings on Diesel as Wars Curb Flows
Commodities.reason: Analyst warnings of soaring diesel margins point to product-market tightness from conflict-related flow disruption — positive for refined products and crude crack spreads (material for energy complex).

Commodities.title: Scramble for gas assets pushes dealmaking to decade high
Commodities.summary: Spending on US projects has soared as national oil companies and traders add to the rush for gas assets
Commodities.reason: Increased dealmaking for gas assets signals tighter supply/strategic buying and stronger long-term demand expectations for gas — supportive for natural gas prices and energy investment flows.

Commodities.title: Dangote refinery drives increase in petroleum shipments from Nigeria
Commodities.summary: Seaborne petroleum product exports from Nigeria have grown seven-fold since 2023, playing an increasing role in the international market for petroleum products at a time when supplies from other areas have been constrained.
Commodities.reason: Rising exports from a new large refinery increase global product supply and can weigh on regional product and crude spreads — modestly negative for prices.

Commodities.title: Eight petroleum liquids pipeline projects have been completed since the start of 2025
Commodities.summary: In the 2026 release of our Liquids Pipeline Projects Database, we tracked the completion of 8 liquid fuels pipeline projects since the start of 2025, and an additional 14 new projects have been announced.
Commodities.reason: New pipeline capacity improves transport logistics and can alleviate regional supply bottlenecks, a modest downward pressure on prices (infrastructure-driven supply improvement).

Crypto.title: Solana vote to double disinflation passes by a hair in dramatic finish
Crypto.reason: Protocol-level cut to token issuance is bullish for Solana's monetary premium and signals governance-driven supply tightening — positive for on-chain asset valuation, medium relevance as chain-specific but market-significant.

Crypto.title: Ethena looks beyond crypto to squeeze yield from booming equity perpetuals
Crypto.reason: Product innovation linking crypto-native firms to equity perpetual markets points to institutional product diversification and yield-seeking, a modest positive for crypto adoption and liquidity.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin barely blinks as U.S. hits Iran, sending oil higher and stocks lower
Crypto.reason: Geopolitical shock with limited BTC reaction suggests resilience/partial decoupling from risk assets — slight positive signal for bitcoin's store-of-value narrative but low market-moving relevance.

Crypto.title: Zcash private transactions could go from three-second waits to under 200 milliseconds
Crypto.reason: Major UX/throughput improvement for privacy transactions strengthens product-market fit for privacy-focused assets, modestly positive for Zcash and privacy-crypto UX adoption.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin Holders Face a Hard Fork on September 1 — Here's What Actually Changes
Crypto.reason: An upcoming Bitcoin hard fork raises short-term operational risk and potential market fragmentation/uncertainty for holders — negative for near-term BTC flows and trading, medium-high relevance.

Crypto.title: U.S. jobs report, Russia’s digital ruble rollout: Crypto Week Ahead
Crypto.reason: CBDC rollouts (digital ruble) and macro calendar items could reshape payments/crypto policy dynamics; marginally negative for private crypto narratives but mostly a watchlist item.

Crypto.title: Luke Dashjr exits mining pool Ocean after split over Bitcoin mining’s future
Crypto.reason: High-profile departure and mining-pool governance split highlight coordination risks in mining infrastructure; small negative for network cohesion and miner-driven narrative.

Crypto.title: Cronos halts blockchain after $75 million lending exploit hits lending app Tectonic
Crypto.reason: Large exploit and chain halt are materially negative for DeFi confidence, security perception and on-chain liquidity on Cronos — high relevance and a clear negative shock to the crypto risk environment.

Crypto.title: Michael Saylor hints at first bitcoin purchase in two months
Crypto.reason: MicroStrategy / Michael Saylor accumulation hints imply renewed institutional demand flow into bitcoin — positive demand signal for BTC price dynamics, moderate relevance.

Crypto.title: Crypto market makers are cashing in on bitcoin's rally - without betting on direction
Crypto.reason: Market-maker strategies harvesting volatility indicate deeper liquidity provision and institutional market structure — constructive for market functioning and risk-taking capacity.

Crypto.title: A $1.1 million crypto card hack crashed a neobank's token 49%
Crypto.reason: Security breach causing a near-50% token crash is a strong negative for trust in tokenized neobank products and highlights operational risk in the ecosystem.

Crypto.title: Ripple is preparing XRP Ledger for quantum computers before ‘Q-Day’ arrives
Crypto.reason: Proactive cryptographic upgrades to guard against future quantum threats improve long-term protocol security and are modestly positive for XRP technical credibility.

Crypto.title: Kalshi takes legal blow in court ruling confirming state powers over prediction markets
Crypto.reason: Court ruling confirming state regulatory authority over prediction markets sets a negative legal precedent for on-chain prediction/derivatives platforms and could tighten enforcement risk.
